content:
maria: Quick sync — were targeting 2026-04-08 11:00am PT for the release post + full rollout. Need changelog link, docs anchor, and confirmation of the rollout cadence by EOD today.

henry: We can do that. Plan is progressive rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20min. Canary starts at 10:40am PT. Ops will hold on alerts and pause if p50 latency rises >30%.

zyra: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/512 — has the new example and migration notes. Waiting for the final perf blurb from eng.

maria: For marketing copy we need a single-sentence performance headline + one supporting stat for the changelog. Short and sticky.

sam: Draft line: "New batching and cache warmup reduce median latency from 140ms to 104ms (25% faster) and lower per-1k token cost by 22%." Ill confirm numbers against the benchmark job and post them here.

henry: Confirmed on rollout cadence. Also adding fallback rule: if error rate >0.8% sustained for 3m, switch traffic back to stable. Rollback window tested in staging.

devops-bot: Release window created: 2026-04-08T17:40:00Z -> 2026-04-08T18:20:00Z (Canary then ramp). Runbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-04-08-v2.

maria: Webinar is scheduled Mon 9:00am PT — product + eng panel. Need a 5-min demo clip of the perf improvements and the one-slide summary for the email. Who owns the clip?

zyra: I can edit the clip once someone records. Henry/sam, can you record a 3-min terminal demo and upload to the drive?

sam: Yep. Will record a short perf run and a quick `kubectl rollback` example. Upload to https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media by tomorrow morning.

maria: Also need inbound lead routing: salesops wants all release-related signups auto-tagged. Salesops: what's the exact tag?

salesops: Use tag = "release_apr2026". Need the webhook payload — can eng add it to the site form handler?

henry: We'll add a small middleware to inject tag on the form submit and send to CRM. Example payload: 

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "name": "Ana Example",
  "tags": ["release_apr2026"],
  "source": "web_release_banner"
}
```

henry: Will spin up the webhook and test against staging by EOD.

maria: Changelog owner? Need a single link we can point to in the post.

zyra: Changelog PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/101 — pending the perf sentence and legal review. Once merged Ill publish the changelog and add the docs anchor.

sam: Bench run finished. Median 140ms -> 104ms; p95 420ms -> 310ms. Cost per 1k tokens: $0.48 -> $0.37. I'm dropping the numbers into the docs PR now.

maria: Perfect. Proposed publish schedule: 11:00am PT post goes live, 11:05am social, 11:10am email send. Marketing will coordinate timings.

henry: Ops monitors during canary. If all clear, ramp to 100% by 11:00am PT. If not, fail back and we postpone publish.

salesops: Confirmed SLA: sales responds to tagged leads within 48 hours. Also please add a hidden field on the webinar reg form for the tag.

zyra: Docs merged and anchor created: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-04-apr — changelog PR updated to point here.

devops-bot: Canary started in EU region. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/67890. Monitor channel: #release-watch.

maria: Upload the short demo clip when ready and share the slide deck link. Ill finalize the email template with the new headline.

sam: Clip uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media/perf-demo.mp4. Slide stub: https://slides.redwood.ai/d/1a2b3c.

henry: All green on rollout. If anything spikes we will cut traffic and alert.

maria: Thanks everyone. Ill hold off on publishing the post until we see the green at 11:00am PT. Ping this thread when changelog is merged + email is queued.

zyra: Changelog merged: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/101/merge — published at 11:01am PT.

maria: Received. Publishing now. :sparkles:

devops-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic. Post-deploy checks passed.

maria: Social and email scheduled/sent. Closing the loop — thanks team!
